## Dashboard UI Layer — Design System, Landing Page, and Responsive Layout

**Status:** Complete. **Date:** 2026-09-15.
**Scope:** UI/UX and responsive layout only. No backend, graph, SQL-generation,
guardrail, or query-processing code was touched, and every existing behavior is
preserved: typed submit, sample-question click, New Chat reset, growing
oldest-first transcript, answer/disclosure rendering, the scope expander, and
the graph invocation path (`dashboard/graph_client.ask`) are unchanged.

### Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `dashboard/app.py` | Thin entry point: page config, style injection, history session state, transcript/welcome switch, composer, ask + rerun. |
| `dashboard/styling.py` | The single global stylesheet (`PAGE_CSS`) plus every color, gradient, icon, and eyebrow constant. Nothing else hardcodes a color. |
| `dashboard/graph_client.py` | Sole owner of `sentrasql_graph` invocations (untouched). |
| `dashboard/components/sidebar.py` | Dark navy rail: real `assets/sentrasql-logo.svg`, two-line tagline, single "New Chat" button. |
| `dashboard/components/question_input.py` | The pinned pill composer: borderless field, example hint, circular send button (keys `question_input` / `ask_button` unchanged). |
| `dashboard/components/welcome_screen.py` | Landing page composition: hero, three sample-question buttons, capability card, scope expander. |
| `dashboard/components/capability_card.py` | "What can you ask?" card: four capability columns, dataset metadata row, "View details" disclosure. Static HTML only. |
| `dashboard/components/answer_display.py` | Answer/error/hint blocks and the disclosures sub-section (visual rules only updated). |
| `dashboard/components/header.py` | **Deleted** — see "Structural fixes" below. |

### Design system

* One palette, defined once in `dashboard/styling.py` and substituted into the
  stylesheet through `@TOKEN` placeholders (replaced longest-name-first, so
  `@TEXT` can never partially rewrite `@TEXT_SECONDARY`). Roles: navy sidebar
  surfaces (`#0B1733` → `#07142F`), light cool canvas (`#F8FAFF`), heading navy
  (`#102044`), primary text (`#14213D`), secondary (`#66779A`), muted
  (`#8794AE`), and one brand blue/purple accent (`#4F6BFF` → `#633BFF`, with
  `#2EA7FF` → `#397CFF` → `#7147F5` for the text gradient).
* One type family: `"Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
  Roboto, sans-serif`. Inter is loaded natively through
  `.streamlit/config.toml` (`[theme] font = "Inter:<google fonts css url>, …"`)
  and the stylesheet declares the same stack, so the app still renders
  correctly if the font request is blocked.
* One icon set: 2px-stroke, round-cap outline glyphs generated by
  `styling._outline_icon(...)` and encoded as `data:image/svg+xml` URIs for the
  CSS-side icons (send, sample cards, plus, chevrons), with the same glyph
  language inlined in the capability card markup.
* Theme tokens in `.streamlit/config.toml` mirror the palette
  (`primaryColor #4F6BFF`, `backgroundColor #F8FAFF`, `textColor #14213D`,
  `borderColor #DCE2F2`, plus a `[theme.sidebar]` section matching the navy
  rail) so Streamlit's own widget chrome matches the custom surfaces.

### No screenshot coordinates anywhere

The layout is fluid by construction; there is no 1672px/941px geometry in the
stylesheet (checked programmatically). The sidebar is
`clamp(240px, 18vw, 280px)`, the content column is `max-width: 1180px` with
`clamp(20px, 3vw, 48px)` gutters, type sizes and spacing are `clamp()`/`vh`
values, and each multi-column block reflows at two breakpoints (1199.98px and
767.98px) plus a short-viewport rule (`max-height: 820px`) for 768px-tall
laptops.

### Structural fixes

1. **Sidebar "New Chat" alignment.** The single design-system gutter
   `--sentrasql-sidebar-gutter` is applied identically to the logo, the
   tagline, and the button's own container, and the button is `width: 100%`
   with `box-sizing: border-box` inside that already-inset box. Because all
   three rows are siblings under the same framework ancestors, their inner
   edges stay aligned regardless of framework padding, and the button can no
   longer overflow or extend past the sidebar at any viewport width.
2. **No redundant page header.** `dashboard/components/header.py` (the white
   "SentraSQL / Natural-language analytics for your sales data" bar) was deleted
   along with its `app.py` wiring and stylesheet section: the brand identity
   lives in the sidebar, so a second branded strip above the hero was
   duplicated chrome. Verified absent from the rendered page.
3. **The composer is always visible.** The pill is rendered on every run
   (landing page included) as a sticky bottom band with `margin-top: auto` on
   the full-height flex column, so short content pushes it to the bottom of the
   viewport and long transcripts scroll beneath it. It is never
   `position: fixed` (see the layout notes in `styling.py`).
4. **"View details" without touching the widget contract.** The AppTest suite
   pins the page's widgets (exactly one sidebar button, exactly three sample
   buttons plus Ask, exactly one `st.expander`), so the capability card's
   disclosure is a native `<details>`/`<summary>` element inside the card's
   static HTML: a real keyboard-accessible control (verified to survive
   Streamlit's markdown sanitiser) that adds no widget. `display: contents`
   lets the summary stay in the metadata grid's last column while its panel
   spans the full card width, with no absolute positioning and no JavaScript.
5. **Decorative background shapes.** The blue/violet glass panels are drawn as
   `::before`/`::after` on `[data-testid="stMain"]` itself, so their containing
   block is guaranteed to be the scrollport, they cannot influence layout, they
   never receive pointer events, and `overflow-x: hidden` on the same node means
   they can never create a horizontal scrollbar. This is the only absolute
   positioning in the stylesheet.

### Responsive behavior

| Range | Composition |
| --- | --- |
| ≥ 1200px | Sidebar visible; hero at full `clamp()` scale; 3 example cards in one row; capability card = intro + 4 capability columns with separators; metadata row single-line with "View details" at the far right. |
| 768–1199px | Sidebar stays usable but narrower (18vw); hero scales down through its `clamp()`; example cards 2 per row; capability card becomes 2 columns with the separators dropped; metadata row wraps to 2 columns with "View details" on its own right-aligned line. |
| < 768px | Sidebar becomes the framework's compact overlay (opened from the top strip, which is deliberately re-shown only here); hero smaller; example cards 1 per row; capability card and metadata stack to a single column; composer keeps natural margins at full width. |
| Height ≤ 820px (desktop) | Hero and card spacing tighten so the landing page fits a 768px-tall laptop viewport. |

### Verification performed

* `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` — 10 passed (headless AppTest against the real
  `dashboard/app.py`, graph stubbed).
* Whole suite — 255 passed, 60 subtests passed.
* Live boot — `streamlit run dashboard/app.py --server.port=8599` served HTTP
  200 with no config or script errors (confirms the `[theme] font` URL form and
  the `[theme.sidebar]` section parse), then the process was stopped.
* Generated stylesheet assertions — 0 leftover `@TOKEN` placeholders, 0 leftover
  icon placeholders, balanced braces (127/127), no empty declaration blocks, no
  hardcoded reference-resolution values, exactly one `position: absolute`
  (the decorative layers) and no `position: fixed`.
* Rendered-markup assertions — capability card, "View details", hero markup, and
  the composer hint all present; the deleted header's copy absent; widget counts
  unchanged (sidebar 1 button, main 4 buttons on the landing page, 1 expander).

### Known limitations / notes

* Inter is loaded over the network (Google Fonts). Offline, the app falls back
  to the declared system stack — by design, so the design never breaks.
* `<details>` + `display: contents` is the mechanism behind "View details". In
  the (unlikely) case an engine ignores `display: contents`, the disclosure
  still opens and closes correctly; only the button's grid placement degrades to
  the right-hand column.
* The top strip is re-shown below 768px *only* to keep the sidebar toggle
  reachable on phones/tablets; it carries no branding, no Deploy button, and no
  menu (those are removed by config plus targeted CSS rules).

## Dashboard UI Layer — Composer Redesign, Hero Description Centering, Legacy Section Removal

**Status:** Complete. **Date:** 2026-09-15 (follow-up correction).
**Scope:** Surgical frontend correction of three areas only — the question
composer, the hero description's container alignment, and the removal of the
duplicate legacy section. The sidebar, logo, New Chat button, hero headline and
gradient, example-question cards, capability-card design, dataset metadata row,
"View details" control, background shapes, palette, and all backend/query logic
were left untouched.

### 1. Composer rebuilt as one component (the real fix)

The old composer was a bordered row whose inner Streamlit input kept its own
BaseWeb box and focus rectangle, and whose example line could escape the pill
because the text column was allowed to shrink (`min-width: 0`) while the hint
was `white-space: nowrap`. Both were structural, not cosmetic, so the composer
was restructured:

* **Pill (`stHorizontalBlock`)** — `display: flex`, `flex-wrap: nowrap`,
  `align-items: center`, `gap: 14px`, `min-height: 76px` with `height: auto`
  (never a rigid height), `padding: 10px 12px 10px 28px`, `border-radius: 38px`,
  `background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96)`, `1px solid rgba(100,120,175,0.15)`,
  `box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(60,80,130,0.10)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`,
  and `overflow: hidden`. `nowrap` stops the send button dropping to a second
  line; `auto` height plus `overflow: hidden` stop the example line escaping.
* **Text area (first column)** — `flex: 1 1 auto`, `min-width: 0`,
  `display: flex`, `flex-direction: column`, `justify-content: center`, so the
  placeholder and the example form ONE block vertically centered in the pill
  (never pinned to an edge). The nested framework wrappers
  (`stVerticalBlock`, `stElementContainer`, `stMarkdown`,
  `stMarkdownContainer`, `stTextInput`, every `[data-baseweb]` node) are
  flattened: `background/border/box-shadow/outline: none`, `margin/padding: 0`,
  `height: auto`, `min-height: 0`, `width: 100%`, `min-width: 0`.
* **Input** — still a real, functional Streamlit input (`st.text_input`,
  key `question_input`); it is transparent, fills the text area, is 28px tall
  with `font: 400 16px/1.4 Inter`, placeholder `#7A88A4`.
* **Example line** — `margin: 3px 0 0 0`, `400 12px/1.4 Inter`, `#8A96B0`,
  `white-space: normal` + `overflow-wrap: anywhere` so it wraps instead of
  overflowing. No absolute positioning, no negative margins.
* **Focus** — the rectangular inner ring is gone; the pill carries the focus
  state via `:focus-within` (`border-color: rgba(79,107,255,0.35)`,
  `box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(60,80,130,0.10), 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,107,255,0.06)`).
* **Send button** — a fixed flex child (`flex: 0 0 52px`, 52x52, `border-radius:
  50%`, brand gradient, `0 6px 18px rgba(79,107,255,0.24)`, 22px white glyph),
  vertically centered by the pill's `align-items`; never absolutely positioned.
* **Responsive tiers** — desktop `padding-left: 28px`/52px button; tablet
  (`max-width: 1023.98px`) `padding: 10px 10px 10px 22px`/50px button; mobile
  (`max-width: 767.98px`) `padding: 9px 8px 9px 18px`, 48px button, 15px input,
  11.5px example line.
* **Width/positioning** — the composer is `width: 100%` of the main content
  column, which already enforces `min(1180px, calc(100% - responsive gutters))`,
  so it is centered within the MAIN CONTENT AREA (not the viewport), never
  overlaps the sidebar, and keeps exactly the same width and center axis as the
  hero and cards above it. Re-applying a second `calc(100% - 48px)` inside that
  column would have made the composer visibly narrower than the rest of the
  page, so it is deliberately not repeated.
* The sticky bottom band is unchanged (intentional): the composer stays visible
  on the landing page and during a conversation.

Two composer colours were added to the palette (`COMPOSER_PLACEHOLDER_COLOR`,
`COMPOSER_HINT_COLOR`) so the new values still live in the design system's
single colour home.

### 2. Hero description centering fixed at the container

`.sentrasql-welcome` is now an explicit `display: block; width: 100%;
box-sizing: border-box; text-align: center` block, and
`.sentrasql-welcome__tagline` is a `width: 100%; max-width: 760px;
margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; box-sizing: border-box` block with
`font: 400 17px/1.6 Inter` and colour `#66779A`, so the paragraph shares exactly
the same horizontal center axis as the headline. The framework element wrapper
around the hero is also centered defensively. No transforms, offsets, relative
positioning, or manual nudging.

### 3. Legacy duplicate section removed

The landing page no longer renders the old "What can I ask about?" expander, so
the hierarchy is now: hero -> example cards -> capability card -> composer. Its
information was NOT deleted: the scope and limitation facts were moved into the
capability card's "View details" panel (`Grain`, `Time range`, `Measures`,
`Coverage`, `Limitations`, `Not yet supported`), which is now their single home.
The capability card, metadata row, and "View details" control itself are
otherwise unchanged. The now-dead `stExpander` CSS was removed.

`tests/test_dashboard_app.py` was updated for the new intended behaviour: the
welcome test now asserts the landing page renders **zero** expanders, that the
legacy label appears nowhere in the page content, and — with the original seven
fact strings unchanged — that every dataset-scope/limitation fact is still
surfaced (now inside the capability card's panel), which is the regression guard
proving the information survived the move.

### Verification performed

* `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` — 10 passed; whole suite — 255 passed,
  60 subtests passed.
* Generated-stylesheet assertions — balanced braces, no leftover `@TOKEN` or
  icon placeholders, pill/textarea/input/hint/button rules present with the
  values above, `overflow: hidden` + `height: auto` + `flex-wrap: nowrap` on the
  pill, no `text-overflow: ellipsis` left anywhere, no dead `stExpander` rules,
  and the only `position: absolute` in the sheet is still the decorative layers.
* Rendered-page assertions — landing page renders no expander; widget contract
  unchanged (sidebar: 1 button; main: three sample buttons + Ask; composer input
  present); capability card, "View details", and the composer hint still
  rendered; the legacy section copy is gone.
* Known limitation of this verification: no browser screenshot was available in
  this environment, so the composer was validated structurally (DOM nesting from
  the headless AppTest run plus stylesheet assertions) rather than by pixel.
